name: Augmented Defender
summary:
Looking for reality based trigger time, that incorporates your home in the experience? We create hardware and software to ground the experience even more in the real world, for the most immersive XR weapon handling experience out there. Once you have the basics down, add stress to the experience by trying to hold off a zombie hoard, trying to invade your home.

Custom Stocks (All) - Full customization
Recommended: XR Pistol, XR-15, Ace Pistol Handset 

Haptic Integration supported:
Protube, Bhaptics

Multip
